people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Riblah
people.line: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah

translations.web: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
translations.bsb: The Chaldeans seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced judgment on Zedekiah.
